Summary: Temptation is the pull toward sin, and Scripture is honest about its universality: even Jesus was tempted, though without sin. Temptation itself is not sin - sin enters when we entertain and yield - and God promises both understanding and a way out, since no temptation is unique to us. The practical defenses are ancient: know Scripture, know your weaknesses, avoid the near occasions, confess quickly, and never fight alone.
